purpose: Local ECOLIVE website assets; source extraction, format optimization and a separately documented Turkish campus-plan localization.
source_integrity: Original supplied documents and images were not modified. Extracted originals are retained. The Turkish campus plan is a separate Imagegen text-localization derivative.
catalogue_structure: All 26 pages contain a single flattened raster. No independent photo or logo objects were available.
